topic: Elvis's last Christmas at Graceland — December 1976
script: Elvis Presley spent seventeen Christmases at Graceland. December 1976 would be the last. He had bought the Memphis mansion in 1957, and every winter he made it glow. Blue lights lined the long driveway. A nativity scene stood on the front lawn. By his own tradition, the decorations stayed up until his birthday on January eighth. That season, at his side was Ginger Alden, twenty years old, whom he had begun dating only weeks before, in November. On New Year's Eve, he was not home. He was onstage in Pittsburgh, where sixteen thousand people packed the Civic Arena to ring in 1977 with him. Weeks later, back at Graceland, he asked Ginger to marry him. He had just turned forty-two. Less than seven months later, he was gone. Graceland still lights the blue driveway every winter. Elvis never saw another Christmas.

sources.claim: Elvis bought Graceland in 1957; spent every Christmas there except three (two in the Army, one in Las Vegas) until 1976, his last holiday — 20 years minus 3 = 17 Christmases
Elvis lined the Graceland driveway with blue lights and decorated the lawn with a Nativity scene; Graceland continues his holiday tradition
Elvis put decorations up early and kept them on display through his Jan. 8 birthday (per Graceland.com)
Ginger Alden born November 13, 1956 (age 20 in Dec 1976); met Elvis at Graceland November 19, 1976
First meeting November 19, 1976; Elvis proposed on January 26, 1977 at Graceland
Dec. 31, 1976 concert at Pittsburgh's Civic Arena; 16,000 fans packed the arena; he died eight months later at age 42
Elvis Presley died August 16, 1977 (less than seven months after the Jan. 26, 1977 proposal); born January 8, 1935, so he had just turned 42 at the proposal
Graceland still lines the driveway with blue lights each holiday season, displayed through Elvis's Jan. 8 birthday
